messages.subject: For Olivier Roussat | Infrastructure, telecoms and government stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Bouygues Investor Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Olivier Roussat, Chief Executive Officer.

Bouygues' diversified portfolio across construction, telecoms and energy services operates across complex public-sector, regulatory and stakeholder environments. That interface closely matches my experience.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I lead senior institutional engagement and coordinate execution across complex regulated operations.

I would welcome a senior discussion about where this combination of government relations, sustainability and multi-sector stakeholder strategy might support Bouygues' international priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Bouygues.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
